title: Support crate: federation peer-auth I/O (key fetch, DNSSEC, cache, replay store)
description: Per JMAP-vjm0 (amended 2026-10-19) and AGENTS.md §Support crates. The I/O half of draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 §Peer Authentication Model (jmap-chat-spec 03985ef L206-230); the pure half is JMAP-kz4f. Scope: unsigned HTTPS GET of https://<peer-domain>/.well-known/jmap with certificate validation against the peer domain and https-only redirects (subject to the draft's SSRF section: consumer-supplied policy hook); key cache bounded by HTTP freshness and max 1 hour; forced refetch on unknown kid, at most once per 60s per peer domain (also re-query _jmap-peer TXT bypassing DNS cache); DNSSEC-validated TXT lookup producing JMAP-kz4f's validation-result enum (trusted-resolver requirement documented); replay store remembering (peer domain, nonce) until expires+60s, in-memory default with a trait for shared stores. Check crates.io for maintained DNSSEC-validating resolvers (e.g. hickory-resolver with dnssec) and HTTP clients already in the dependency tree. Not a dependency of any *-types or *-server crate.
acceptance_criteria: Cache/refetch/rate-limit timing tested with an injected clock; DNSSEC result mapping tested per enum case with a stub resolver; replay store tests for duplicate rejection and expiry; HTTPS fetch tested against a local TLS stub including redirect-to-http rejection.
